## What happened?

Describe the observed result and the result you expected.

## How can it be reproduced?

Include the exact command, package version or commit, and whether you used
inspection, strict verification, or a fresh experiment. Include a minimal
synthetic example when relevant.

## Environment and evidence

Provide Python/NumPy versions and the complete diagnostic error. For strict
primary verification, include the reported runtime/source differences. For a
fresh experiment, retain the plan, all candidate results, and any failure record.
Remove credentials and private data from material you post.

## Changes already tried

Describe any changes to code, data, parameters, or the runtime. Do not overwrite
the original evidence or silently replace an unfavorable run.
